subject: The secret mistake 90% of users make with healing
preview_text: Psychology Today just revealed what most people get wrong about moving on. It changes everything.
body_paragraphs: I got an email from a reporter at Psychology Today last month. She was writing a piece on digital therapy tools and asked to interview me about Fresh Start. Her first question stopped me cold: 'Why does your approach work when so many others fail?'

I told her the truth most apps won't: healing isn't about forgetting your ex. It's about rebuilding your identity. That's what the experts confirmed. The review just published, and they called our method 'the most psychologically sound breakup tool available' because it targets identity loss directly, not just the sadness.

That's why every feature in the app, especially the guided journaling prompts, is designed by therapists to reconstruct who you are outside that relationship. The reviewers specifically highlighted how our 'Identity Rediscovery' exercises help rewire those obsessive thoughts.

Open the app and tap into the Journal section. Do the prompt called 'Who Was I Before?' It's the exercise the article praised most. Do it now, before the old story replays in your head again. P.S. The reporter confessed she tried the app herself after writing the piece. She said the 3AM emergency mode saved her one night last week.
